correctness.rationale: The source-backed total Chern-class identity gives the displayed Euler formula after exact coefficient extraction. For a balancing move, the degree-product pair factor rises by delta while the second symmetric factor falls by delta, yielding an exact change P*delta*(C-B-delta). In codimension two the final factor equals (x-1)^2+(y-2)^2-2 and is negative only at (1,3); with at least one additional shifted degree the extra contribution is at least 3, making every balancing move strictly positive. This proves all maxima and minima, and the exact checker independently reproduces the formulas and bounded cases.
